missables.body: PowerPyx and GTABase agree: of all 55 trophies, only Positive Mental Attitude is potentially missable. Everything else is either an automatic story trophy or stays available in free-roam after the story, and there are no missable trophies among the collectibles, races or robberies. The 100% checklist has nothing missable in it at all.
missables.headline: Only one trophy can be missed
not_missable: Story mission trophies — they pop automatically as you play the missions.
Optional-mission questlines (Andy, Billy, Kenton, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) — quest givers may go quiet for a while, but they all come back and the quests stay available after the story.
Collectibles (cards, WAiNK scans, vehicles, meditation spots) — all reachable in free-roam, and the 100% checklist only ever asks for part of each set.
Robberies and gang operations — repeatable and still there after the story.
Strangers & Freaks — still there after the story.

the_one.save_advice: Because there is no mission replay, keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter — 15 manual slots, so a save at each chapter boundary (10 saves) plus 5 rotating saves for free-roam cleanup is the pattern PowerPyx recommends.
the_one.what: In Chapter 1, after the main mission 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning. She says 'You know what I'm gonna do? Meditate', walks to the balcony — follow her, choose 'Accept', and she teaches you to meditate.
the_one.why_it_matters: That balcony meditation is only available during Chapter 1. Whether it is strictly required is still unconfirmed (it raises the counter by 1 but isn't marked as a 'Meditation Spot'), and PowerPyx's author had done it when the trophy popped. Do it to be safe.

stages.name: Finish the story — and mind the one missable
stages.summary: Play the 5 story chapters (Chapters 1-4 have completion trophies; the final mission has the gold). Do side content as it appears: scan vehicles with the WaiNK app, study animals with binoculars, and take optional missions as they show up — progress already counts toward the 100% checklist, which you can't see until after the story.
tips: Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before Chapter 1 ends — the only potentially missable trophy (see the Missables tab).
There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter. The game has 15 manual save slots and 1 autosave slot.
Cheats disable trophies and saving — keep them off for the whole run.
Optional missions (purple icons, and black icons with pink letters) disappear after a while, but there are 200-300+ of them and only 100 are needed for 100%, so missing some costs nothing.
Quest givers can go quiet for a while (Kenton after Chapter 1, for example) and come back later — no trophy questline is lost that way.

checklist: Scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles with the WaiNK app
Complete 300 stunts (any mix of 130 jumps, 202 under-bridge, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps)
All robberies: jewelry stores, Payday Loans, bank vaults (8 large bank jobs)
All 39 illegal gang operations (one per gang, 9 gangs)
All shooting ranges (42 gold medals) and all drone races (14 locations, 42 races)
stages.name: The 100% Completion Checklist
stages.summary: After the story you return to free-roam and the checklist unlocks under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. It is lenient — closer to 60% true completion — and nothing in it is missable. Most of it will already be partway done from Stage 1.
tips: Work the checklist in the order the map shows: unfog the map first (The Goodtime State), then sweep each region's stunts, scans and operations.
Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each — they fund the garages and the $100,000 of shopping on the way.
Do the 100% checklist before the Strangers & Freaks cleanup: it unlocks most of the activity trophies by itself.

stages.name: Strangers & Freaks and miscellaneous cleanup
stages.summary: Strangers & Freaks are not needed for 100%, so they may still be open. Finish the 8 counting strands, then mop up whatever is left: card sets, the last shops and garages, the partner trophies and the odd one-out trophies whose methods were still unconfirmed at launch.
tips: Only certain stranger strands count for Strangers & Freaks (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete and more being confirmed) — the named-character questlines do not count.

Four trophies had no confirmed method at launch (In The Beginning…, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There, Ten Pin). Their guide entries say so plainly — check the sources linked on each trophy for updates.
When the last trophy pops, the platinum 'Vice Got a Price!' follows at once.

subtitle: Built from the official trophy descriptions and PowerPyx's roadmap (difficulty 4/10, about 200 hours, one playthrough, no online trophies, no mission replay). The story is 5 chapters and takes 60-80 hours; the 100% checklist is the long part.
title: Roadmap to the Platinum
